announcements.text: Phoenix Defense Ventures LLC,* Phoenix, Arizona, has been awarded a $310,498,639 task order for programmed flying training, schoolhouse academics, simulator training operations, and opposition forces training, in order to execute aircrew initial qualification training, aircrew mission qualification training, aircrew transition training, aircrew conversion training, instructor upgrade training, instrument refresher training, and various other courses for the HH-60W Combat Rescue Helicopter. Work will be performed in Phoenix, Arizona; Kirtland Air Force Base, New Mexico; Moody AFB, Georgia; Patrick Space Force Base, Florida; Nellis AFB, Nevada; Davis-Monthan AFB, Arizona; Joint Base Elmendorf-Richardson, Alaska; Gabreski Air National Guard Base, New York; Moffett ANGB, California; Fort Eustis, Virginia; Kadena Air Base, Japan; Aviano AB, Italy; and Joint Base Andrews, Maryland, and is expected to be completed by Dec. 31, 2027, with yearly options through Dec. 31, 2033. This task order is the result of a competitive fair opportunity purchase request under the Air Force Training Systems Acquisition IV program, and five offers were received. Fiscal 2027 operation and maintenance funds in the amount of $5,638 are being obligated at the time of award. The Air Force Life Cycle Management Center, Wright-Patterson AFB, Ohio, is the contracting activity (FA8692-27-F-B002). (Awarded on Oct 27, 2026).

announcements.text: CAE USA Inc., Arlington, Texas, has been awarded a $14,800,647 hybrid firm-fixed-price contract for Taiwan Air Force F-16 Block 20V and Block 70 Mission Training Center Program contractor logistics support (CLS)-futures. This contract provides CLS, spares management, travel, data, and dislocation. Work will be performed outside the continental U.S.; Chiayi, Hualien, and Taitung, Taiwan; and within the continental U.S., at Morris Air National Guard Base, Tucson, Arizona, and is expected to be completed by Jan. 30, 2032. This contract involves Foreign Military Sales (FMS) to Taiwan. This contract was a sole-source acquisition. FMS funds in the amount of $2,234,180 are being obligated at the time of award. The Air Force Life Cycle Management Center, Wright-Patterson Air Force Base, Ohio, is the contracting activity (FA8621-27-C-B001). (Awarded on Oct. 28, 2026).

announcements.text: SupplyCore Inc.,* Rockford, Illinois, has been awarded a maximum $80,000,000 firm-fixed-price, indefinite-delivery/indefinite-quantity contract for facilities maintenance, repair and operations supplies. This was a sole-source acquisition using justification 10 U.S. Code 3204(a)(1), as stated in Federal Acquisition Regulation 6.103-1. This is a 212-day bridge contract with no option periods. Locations of performance Nebraska, Ohio, Illinois, Indiana, Wisconsin, Iowa, Minnesota, South Dakota, Missouri, Kentucky, North Dakota, and Michigan with a June 2, 2027, ordering period end date. Using customers are Army, Navy, Air Force, Marine Corps, and Coast Guard. Type of appropriation is fiscal 2027 defense working capital funds. The contracting activity is Defense Logistics Agency Troop Support, Philadelphia, Pennsylvania (SPE8E3-27-D-0002).

announcements.text: General Dynamics Electric Boat Corp., Groton, Connecticut, is awarded a $14,513,267 undefinitized contract action under a previously awarded contract (N00024-12-C-2115) in support of the USS Idaho (SSN 799) Post Delivery Work Period. Work will be performed in Groton, Connecticut, and is expected to be completed by December 2027. Fiscal 2026 shipbuilding and conversion (Navy) $10,884,950 will be obligated at the time of award and will not expire at the end of the current fiscal year. Supervisor of Shipbuilding Conversion and Repair, Groton, Connecticut, is the contracting activity.
